scope: Current level-60 DPS and tank scenarios, plus conditional spell, item and encounter coverage. This register consolidates the recorded questions; it is not a claim that unlisted game behavior has been verified.
coverage: Read the legacy in-game checks, dispositions, demo checklist, all eleven class/shared/consumable beta-pass reports, mechanics/history/MythicSim/weekly/latest-upstream reviews and tank report. Screened the other top-level source, gear, race, Tier, haste, spell-inventory and patch reports for unresolved claims.

Reviewed 137 spell-manifest records selected for assumed, unreviewed or uncertainty-bearing notes. A manifest label is provenance, not proof of an active bug: stale labels such as Bloodthrill's borrowed ID and Quick Strikes being absent are superseded by current code.

Screened 267 matching runtime comment lines. Unknown-enum names, implementation-language assumptions and unrelated Classic/legacy encounter TODOs are not gameplay questions. Real-item proc/guardian notes remain source-indexed conditional work under DATA-006 and DATA-007.

Generated historical build tables are not independent sources. Their current caveats are represented by class entries; old result counts, paid-hit conventions and unreplayed research are not relabeled as current evidence.

Private chat and combat-log identifiers remain local. Public source links and the committed review conclusions provide the shareable evidence trail. This is consolidation and current-code reconciliation, not a fresh in-game verification of every mechanic.

items.title: Boss attack tables
items.question: What are level-60 miss, dodge, parry, crit-suppression and glancing rules against level-63 targets?
items.current_model: Forever uses the explicit attack-table changes in the engine, with remaining inherited formulas. Demo columns and research checklists do not establish every boss case.
items.impact: All melee, ranged and tank comparisons; hit caps and crit value.
items.resolution: Capture a large controlled attack sample with known skill, hit, crit, target level and facing. Separate white, queued, special and ranged attacks; retain low-level checks as partial evidence.

items.title: Energy regeneration and haste
items.question: Does general haste increase Energy regeneration, and do attack-speed-only effects leave it unchanged?
items.current_model: 10 Energy/sec integrated in 100-ms steps; general haste provisionally increases the rate. Slice and Dice, Berserking and attack-only enchants do not. The step size is not a measured server tick.
items.impact: Feral and all Rogue builds; haste and resource value.
items.resolution: Compare uncapped recovery over long matched windows with zero and known general haste, excluding spends, refunds and other energizes. The existing 1% sample is not precise enough to establish the effect. Test attack-speed-only effects separately.

items.title: Energy refunds on avoided attacks
items.question: Which builders and finishers refund Energy on miss, dodge or parry, and what fraction of the paid cost returns?
items.current_model: Inherited 80% builder refunds; damaging finishers generally do not refund. Costs are charged before the outcome.
items.impact: Feral and Rogue resource supply, especially before hit cap or when attacking from the front.
items.resolution: Log resource values around isolated avoided builders and finishers at known costs. Record combo-point retention separately. Do not infer a universal refund from one ability.

items.title: Spell GCD versus physical GCD
items.question: Which speed effects shorten magical and physical GCDs, and what is the minimum?
items.current_model: The adopted WoWSims-style rule hastes magical GCDs with casting speed, retains fixed physical GCDs, and uses a one-second floor. Missing magical schools were corrected across the audited utility spells.
items.impact: All rotations; especially instant Shaman spells and physical 1.5-second abilities.
items.resolution: Measure repeated casts with known speed effects and client GCD categories. Compare magical instant spells against physical abilities and fixed one-second actions; include latency/error bounds.

items.title: Channel speed sources
items.question: Which general-haste effects compress channels, distinct from casting-speed-only effects?
items.current_model: Separate SpellHaste scales supported channels provisionally. Berserking speeds hardcasts but not Arcane Missiles; Missile Barrage has its own explicit tick period. No selected item supplies raw SpellHaste.
items.impact: Mage, Priest and Warlock channels; hypothetical haste scaling.
items.resolution: Time all ticks and completion under individually isolated general haste, casting speed and explicit channel modifiers. Existing Mage observations support the Berserking distinction, not a universal aura-65 rule.

items.title: Optional MP5-per-second interpretation
items.question: Does a flat displayed MP5 point restore one mana per five seconds or per second?
items.current_model: Ordinary MP5/5 per second is the default. The explicit optional mode multiplies only the MP5 stat contribution by five; it is off in rankings.
items.impact: Mana users if enabled; does not establish a current ranking error.
items.resolution: Compare matched uncapped mana recovery with a known flat MP5 delta, both while spending mana and outside the five-second rule. Keep Spirit and direct returns constant; a tooltip or OOM result alone is insufficient.

items.title: Judgement of Wisdom trigger rules
items.question: Which events trigger Wisdom, at what probability and with what cooldown?
items.current_model: The level-60 return is 59 mana. The inherited event/proc model, including its 50% chance, remains provisional; self-hits are excluded.
items.impact: Mana sustainability of melee Hunters, Paladins and other frequent attackers.
items.resolution: Use a controlled, isolated Wisdom target; count eligible white, special, spell, periodic and proc events against mana returns. Repeat with fast attacks to identify an ICD.

items.title: Dynamic periodic damage boundaries
items.question: Which damage components update during an existing DoT, and which cast-specific bonuses remain attached?
items.current_model: Forever periodic damage uses dynamic stats/modifiers under the adopted no-snapshot model, with explicit cast-specific effects and Ignite exclusions. Deep Wounds also reads current weapon/AP state.
items.impact: All DoT builds; temporary buffs, weapon swaps and poison upkeep.
items.resolution: Apply one DoT, change one stat or damage buff mid-duration without reapplying, and compare ticks. Test cast-only charge buffs separately from ordinary stats; distinguish a proc payload from an ordinary DoT.
legacy: T52 in in_game_checks.md (dynamic DoTs) / T02 Deep Wounds follow-up / T35 periodic scope

items.title: Eureka cast and periodic bonuses
items.question: Does the last Eureka charge benefit every tick of the consuming channel/DoT after the aura expires?
items.current_model: Charged casts preserve a tagged bonus; ordinary periodic stat updates remain separate. Cost reductions follow the engine's additive convention.
items.impact: Gnome resource use and damage, particularly channels.
items.resolution: Spend the last charge on a channel and a DoT, then compare all ticks with uncharged controls. Check simultaneous proc/cast completion and damage-free actions.

items.title: Read Ley Line regeneration
items.question: Which regeneration components does High Order's active ability increase, and does location matter?
items.current_model: The active regeneration effect is not used; a nearby ley line is not assumed.
items.impact: Potential High Order mana recovery; currently absent rather than a free benefit.
items.resolution: Read the current ability/acquisition text, then compare flat MP5 and Spirit recovery while casting and idle, with location recorded.

items.title: Base attributes and class conversions
items.question: Are level-60 naked attributes and attribute-to-crit/resource conversions correct for every supported race/class?
items.current_model: Retained class/race tables with explicit Forever racial changes. Another fork's level-70 attributes were not imported.
items.impact: Every comparison; physical Agility crit versus caster Intellect crit and tank health.
items.resolution: Obtain naked level-60 character/API values for each supported combination and isolate class conversion slopes. Low-level observations cannot establish the max-level rows.

items.title: Tea and conjured-item shared cooldowns
items.question: Which consumables share cooldowns with Thistle Tea, including prepull uses?
items.current_model: Rogues and Cats can use the sourced 100 Energy, five-minute Tea. The inherited cross-conjured shared-category handling is retained.
items.impact: Feral/Rogue resource plans and mixed consumable configurations.
items.resolution: Use Tea and each selectable conjured alternative in both orders; record category cooldowns and combat transitions. Do not retest the already sourced 100 Energy amount.

items.title: Level-60 outgoing rage normalization
items.question: Do the measured low-level speed-based rage rates persist at level 60?
items.current_model: Damage-independent rage: base weapon speed × 4.5 for two-handers, or × (4.5/1.3) for one-hand main hand. Crits/glances do not increase it; haste changes swing frequency, not rage per hit.
items.impact: All Warrior damage, gear selection and rotation decisions.
items.resolution: Collect unclipped resource deltas with known weapon speeds at higher levels, holding damage and haste independently variable. Existing level-8–20 logs support only that measured range.

items.title: Off-hand and extra-swing rage
items.question: What rage do off-hand, avoided and proc-generated swings award?
items.current_model: Half-rate off-hand before the sourced Dual Wield Specialization multiplier; avoided autos award none. This is not a measured complete level-60 Fury rule.
items.impact: Fury, Windfury and weapon-proc value.
items.resolution: Separate MH/OH and extra attacks in an uncapped resource log; isolate talent rank, avoidance outcome and proc source. Keep ordinary-hit measurements separate.

items.title: Incoming rage and mitigation
items.question: Does unmitigated damage × 10 / maximum health explain incoming rage at all armor/health values?
items.current_model: That formula is used for Forever Warriors. The low-level doubled low-armor cluster and higher-level behavior remain unexplained; other classes retain their separate rules.
items.impact: Protection rotation, self-damage resource gains and tank stat trade-offs.
items.resolution: Repeat matched incoming hits at several armor and maximum-health values; account for concurrent outgoing swings and resource caps. Extend the sample to level 60 later.

items.title: Berserker Rage's extra incoming rage
items.question: Is the bonus a flat amount, a multiplier, or a damage-dependent rule?
items.current_model: Inherited +2 rage on landed melee/ranged hits and a separate damage-based spell-hit bonus; a proposed 2× rule was not adopted without evidence.
items.impact: Incoming-damage Warrior scenarios and stance/cooldown choices.
items.resolution: Compare otherwise identical incoming hits with and without Berserker Rage, including melee and spells, at known maximum health and armor.

items.title: Queued Heroic Strike/Cleave hit table
items.question: Does queueing suppress the off-hand dual-wield miss penalty at level 60?
items.current_model: Attacks remain queued replacements; the penalty is removed only while a queue is active. Low-level observations support the effect, not its full boss-level magnitude.
items.impact: Fury hit requirements, queue timing and resource optimization.
items.resolution: Repeat the queued/unqueued off-hand comparison with sufficient attacks, known skill/hit and a level-63 target. Include cancel-before-MH cases.

items.title: Flurry amount and charge events
items.question: Which events proc, refresh and spend Flurry, and does the talent curve or triggered aura determine speed?
items.current_model: 5–25% melee speed; three shared charges. White-tagged events, including avoided swings and queued replacements, consume charges without a 500-ms gate. Melee crits refill after consumption. Each Cleave target may consume a charge.
items.impact: All Flurry builds, especially dual wield and cleave.
items.resolution: Record aura stacks and swing timestamps around crits, avoided MH/OH attacks, simultaneous swings and multi-target Cleave. Compare ranks. Issue 12 is a research plan, not a measured answer.

items.title: Unbridled Wrath beta fix status
items.question: Has the acknowledged lower-than-intended beta proc rate been corrected?
items.current_model: Uses intended 12% per point on ordinary landed white swings. Heroic Strike and Cleave are excluded following observed eligibility.
items.impact: Warrior rage supply; intended model may differ from a live beta bug.
items.resolution: Count eligible swings and energizes at known rank on the current build; distinguish rate from eligibility and confirm the deployed fix.

items.title: Shield attacks and weapon procs
items.question: Can Shield Slam and Shield Bash trigger main-hand effects such as Windfury?
items.current_model: Shield Slam is a main-hand special here; Shield Bash is not registered. Another implementation moved shield attacks off-hand, but its simulations do not prove server eligibility.
items.impact: Protection DPS, rage and threat. Shield Slam requires later access.
items.resolution: Test Shield Bash in game with a known main-hand proc and no intervening autos, then repeat Shield Slam when available; also verify hit/modifier rules before changing masks.

items.title: Sunder Armor AP threat coefficient
items.question: What AP-scaled threat was added by the patch beyond the explicit rank threat?
items.current_model: Rank-5 flat threat is 206; no extra AP coefficient is invented from the development-note wording.
items.impact: Protection and Fury Sunder threat, not Sunder armor reduction or direct DPS.
items.resolution: Measure threat from isolated Sunders at matched rank and different AP. Separate stance/talent multipliers and the first application from refreshes.

items.title: Weaponmaster hand-specific armor ignore
items.question: Can an off-hand mace grant the character-wide armor discount, and how does it stack?
items.current_model: The retained equipment gate can grant it from an off-hand mace. The competing upstream main-hand-only rule is not verified.
items.impact: Mixed-weapon Warrior alternatives, not evidence for a free generic armor reduction.
items.resolution: Compare otherwise identical MH/OH placements with controlled target armor; isolate sword procs and armor-ignore stacking.

items.title: Overpower/Revenge cooldown and Focused Rage
items.question: Are the earlier independent-timer and undiscounted Demoralizing Shout findings still current?
items.current_model: No. Warrior.Initialize passes one timer to Overpower and Revenge. Demoralizing Shout carries SpellFlagOffensive, so Focused Rage discounts it.
items.impact: The old follow-up report must not create duplicate fixes or false candidate gains.
items.resolution: Closed by tracing current registration and modifier predicates. The separate absent Shield Bash action remains WAR-012.

items.title: Shield Bash registration
items.question: Can tanks use the sourced shield interrupt without bypassing Pummel's cooldown category?
items.current_model: Pummel is registered; Shield Bash is absent from Warrior.Initialize. The old report claiming two live independent timers overstated current coverage.
items.impact: Protection interrupt/utility completeness, not damage in a noncasting reference boss.
items.resolution: Add current rank damage/cost, shield/stance requirements and shared category with Pummel; test both cast orders and preserve the unresolved weapon-proc question separately.

items.title: Seal of Righteousness spell-power formula
items.question: Should the proc add SP once or twice, and is the retained two-hand 1.1 factor real in Forever?
items.current_model: Retains the double-add formula and two-hand factor inherited from older testing. A client coefficient alone does not validate the full formula.
items.impact: Both Ret gear archetypes and Protection damage/threat; high-impact scaling uncertainty.
items.resolution: Compare matched low-rank procs with two known SP values on one- and two-hand weapons of recorded speeds. Remove target Holy bonuses, then test them separately.

items.title: Seal Echo coexistence and consumption
items.question: Can separate Command/Righteousness Echoes coexist, and what exactly spends them?
items.current_model: Separate one-charge Echoes wait for a landed white swing. Avoided swings and melee-classified Judgements do not consume them.
items.impact: Ret seal-weaving damage; the talent itself needs later access.
items.resolution: Obtain the talent when available and log both aura states while replacing seals, then white hits, misses and Judgements. Low-level seal damage tests do not answer Echo coexistence.

items.title: Windfury Totem proc and charge rules
items.question: Which specials/seal procs trigger Totem, how are AP charges spent, and do extra attacks reset ordinary swings?
items.current_model: Separate party buff, exclusive with Grace; not a weapon imbue. Retained ICD, extra-swing timing and seal eligibility remain inherited. There is no second 20% roll to spend a charge.
items.impact: All melee and tank rows; Ret's autoattack gain can exceed the displayed 20% proc chance because specials also trigger swings.
items.resolution: Capture event order and buff charges for autos, specials, seals, avoided hits and extra attacks. Isolate Totem from Windfury Weapon and other extra-swing effects.

items.title: Holy melee partial resistance
items.question: Do melee-table Holy strikes and seal damage take partial resists?
items.current_model: Current melee hit/crit handling retains the applicable resistance path; table classification alone does not settle partial resistance.
items.impact: Paladin damage and threat against higher-level targets.
items.resolution: Inspect controlled Holy Strike/seal damage and explicit resist events against targets of known levels; separate misses from partial resists.

items.title: Seal of Fury and its judgement
items.question: What supported Seal of Fury functionality is still missing from Protection?
items.current_model: No Seal of Fury selection, damage proc, judgement, absorb or Improved Seal of Fury mana return. Protection currently uses Righteousness.
items.impact: Major Protection completeness gap; may change gear, rotation, survival and threat.
items.resolution: Implement sourced ranks, costs and known effects with separate explicit choices for unresolved proc/combat-table/shield behavior. Validate the damage and resource paths before optimizing around them.

items.title: Seal of Fury shield replacement and mana
items.question: Does a new proc replace or add to the shield, and which depletion events restore mana?
items.current_model: Not implemented. A competing simulator's replacement/fully-depleted rule is explicitly provisional, not game evidence.
items.impact: Protection survival and resource sustain; must not grant free mana on expiry or replacement without support.
items.resolution: Track absorb amounts through successive procs, partial/full damage, expiry and recast. Test talented mana at later access, including attacker-level scaling and block/absorb ordering.

items.title: Hammer of the Righteous availability
items.question: Is the retained spell actually learnable, and what shares its cooldown?
items.current_model: Not enabled merely from a leftover rune/class-skill record.
items.impact: Potential Protection AoE action; absent from current rotations.
items.resolution: Obtain trainer/spellbook evidence and current cooldown behavior before importing the former rune implementation.

items.title: Vindication's target AP reduction
items.question: Does the target-side part of Vindication reduce incoming damage?
items.current_model: Only the Paladin AP gain is implemented. The old comment that enemy AP is never read is no longer true for tank encounters.
items.impact: Tank mitigation and fair talent selection.
items.resolution: Resolve the current target-effect amount/scope from client data, implement the debuff with correct exclusivity and measure incoming swings before/after. Keep the known owner AP effect separate.

items.title: Consecrated Ground per-target coverage
items.question: Does its mitigation affect only enemies covered by the capped Consecration component?
items.current_model: A buff on the Paladin applies broadly rather than tracking up to four affected attackers.
items.impact: Protection pulls above four enemies; not a missing single-target DPS coefficient.
items.resolution: Implement target-scoped mitigation using current effect masks/cap and test five or more attackers. Terrain and vertical geometry remain a separate scenario limitation.

items.title: Retribution Aura provider scaling
items.question: How should the aura use its provider's SP rather than the recipient's?
items.current_model: The retained shared aura lacks the sourced scaling follow-up; stationary DPS receives no retaliation because it is not attacked.
items.impact: Tanks, solo damage and multi-player buff modeling.
items.resolution: Check the current client/measurement coefficient and implement a provider-aware amount. Test self-provided and external auras separately; no free recipient-SP scaling.

items.title: Redoubt proc curve
items.question: Does Redoubt proc at 2/4/6/8/10% by rank?
items.current_model: Uses that trait curve and 6% block per point. The curve's proc interpretation is inferred from its top-rank match to the aura data.
items.impact: Protection block uptime and defensive talent value.
items.resolution: Count qualifying incoming events and procs at multiple ranks, separating active-aura refreshes and five-charge expiration.

items.title: Echo of Justice proc probability
items.question: What is its intended proc probability after the excessive-rate beta fix?
items.current_model: No demonstrated source-supported implementation is enabled for the unsupported effect.
items.impact: Conditional talent/item interactions; not a granted ranking bonus.
items.resolution: Resolve the current trigger spell and probability or measure eligible events after the server fix; patch wording alone does not supply a rate.

items.title: Omen of Clarity proc frequency
items.question: Is the client's 100% field a literal proc guarantee after the ten-second ICD?
items.current_model: Direct eligible events grant one free-action charge after the ICD under a provisional literal interpretation; Wrath and resource-free actions do not spend it.
items.impact: Feral and Balance resources, and Bear choices where eligible.
items.resolution: Count eligible direct events, procs and ICD intervals with no unrelated Clearcasting sources. Test consumption separately; a dummy proc field is not a measured frequency.

items.title: Furor's lower-rank Energy carryover
items.question: How are carried Energy, time out of form and the rank-dependent cap combined?
items.current_model: Out-of-form timestamps reset correctly, including prepull/time-zero exits. Lower-rank carry/cap interpretation remains provisional.
items.impact: Alternate Feral shift builds; current no-Furor profiles do not establish the rule.
items.resolution: Record entering/leaving Cat at controlled Energy, elapsed time and multiple talent ranks. Separate the timestamp bug already fixed from unknown server semantics.

items.title: Form weapon damage and flat imbues
items.question: Which equipped weapon damage and flat imbue bonuses affect Cat/Bear form attacks?
items.current_model: Retains form-weapon damage rules rather than ordinary equipped-weapon DPS scaling. Another fork preserving an imbue through form changes is not evidence of eligibility.
items.impact: Feral/Bear weapons, stones and damage scaling.
items.resolution: Swap weapons with matched attributes but different damage, then isolate a flat weapon enchant. Record naked form damage, AP and unchanged attack speed.

items.title: Thick Hide Defense coefficient
items.question: What amount of armor does each Defense point contribute in each form?
items.current_model: Armor updates dynamically with form and bonus Defense, but the retained coefficient has conflicting raw-scalar/rank-text provenance.
items.impact: Bear gearing, mitigation and normalized defensive-stat value.
items.resolution: Resolve trait-curve units with current tooltip variables; verify known Defense deltas in and out of form. Do not treat correct dynamic updates as validation of the scalar.

items.title: Bear threat multipliers
items.question: What are Forever's form, Primal Bite, Lacerate and Swipe threat multipliers?
items.current_model: Bear form 1.3×, Primal Bite 1.5×, Lacerate 3.33× and Swipe 2× retain inherited components without complete Forever threat measurements.
items.impact: Tank threat coverage and comparisons; these must not be marketed as verified threat formulas.
items.resolution: Measure per-action threat with known damage, form and talents. Test each action independently, including non-damaging/flat components and multi-target distribution.

items.title: Lacerate direct and periodic formula
items.question: Are the stack-dependent weapon term and bleed base the correct Forever damage formula?
items.current_model: 10% form weapon damage per resulting stack and level-dependent bleed base per stack; inherited interpretations remain unvalidated.
items.impact: Bear rotation and damage, distinct from its threat multiplier.
items.resolution: Compare first through fifth applications and ticks at controlled AP/weapon state; reconcile the current child effect IDs and tooltip variables before optimizing around a suspected formula.

items.title: Improved Moonfire SP scope
items.question: Does Improved Moonfire multiply only base damage or the SP contribution too?
items.current_model: Retains a base-damage modifier. Moonfury's separate school-wide modifier has already been corrected and is not the same open question.
items.impact: Balance Moonfire contribution.
items.resolution: Compare talent ranks with two controlled SP totals, separately for direct and periodic damage; resolve the current family modifier if sufficient.

items.title: Nature's Grace GCD stacking and timing
items.question: Does its explicit GCD reduction stack with cast-speed-based GCD reduction, and when does Wrath trigger it?
items.current_model: Applies both explicit -10% GCD and +10% cast speed; Wrath retains the inherited completion-time proc timing.
items.impact: Balance cast cadence, instant-spell GCD and buff uptime.
items.resolution: Measure GCDs under the aura versus equivalent casting speed and compare proc timestamps at different projectile travel distances.

items.title: Insect Swarm's final partial tick
items.question: Does the Tier 1 duration extension award a fractional final tick?
items.current_model: Fifteen seconds at a two-second interval yields seven full ticks and one second of remaining aura; no half tick is invented.
items.impact: Balance Tier gain.
items.resolution: Log a full uninterrupted application with the set effect; compare final tick count, amount and expiration time.

items.title: Feral stealth openers
items.question: What is needed to support Prowl, Ravage and Pounce?
items.current_model: No opening stealth state or those attacks. Their contribution is absent rather than estimated.
items.impact: Feral opener completeness, especially short fights.
items.resolution: Implement sourced ranks, form/position/stealth conditions and one-time opener state; verify against current client data before testing alternatives.

items.title: Proc enchants in animal forms
items.question: Can Cat and Bear trigger Crusader, and which weapon speed determines its proc rate?
items.current_model: The generic enchant handler permits form melee attacks and retains a 1-PPM rule. The selected Bear gear and an existing Night Elf Feral profile use Crusader; Forever form eligibility has not been demonstrated.
items.impact: Druid enchant selection, temporary Strength and resulting damage/threat. Simulation confirmation does not establish that the proc occurs in game.
items.resolution: Isolate the enchanted weapon in and out of form, recording attack/proc timestamps and both equipped-weapon and form swing speeds. If the effect is ineligible, remove its form benefit and refresh affected profiles.

items.title: Pet owner-stat inheritance
items.question: Do the wiki's AP, SP, hit, crit, Stamina and armor coefficients hold for Hunter and Warlock pets?
items.current_model: Explicit Forever wiki-derived inheritance is enabled for both families provisionally. The earlier zero-inheritance notes are superseded. Explicit pet talents are additional, not duplicate inheritance.
items.impact: All pet builds; owner gear scaling and pet survivability.
items.resolution: Change one owner stat at a time and inspect pet stats/damage. Check dynamic gain/loss, school choice and Warlock Intellect-to-mana separately; retain the shared rule unless evidence distinguishes families.

items.title: Pet per-hit damage versus speed
items.question: Do pets of different base speeds deal equal per-hit damage, including AP scaling?
items.current_model: Selected Classic-style pet speeds are retained; the equal-hit model uses the adopted reference-speed treatment rather than normalizing DPS across speeds.
items.impact: Pet choice and Hunter/Warlock melee contribution.
items.resolution: Compare same-level pets with controlled owner stats, family modifiers and targets; record damage distributions and intervals, not tooltip DPS alone.

items.title: Pet external buffs and action cadence
items.question: Which external buffs reach pets, and how quickly does pet AI spend Focus or mana?
items.current_model: Generic external player buffs are excluded under the adopted common pet model. Focus base regeneration/cap are client-backed; action scheduling is a simulator approximation.
items.impact: Pet damage and resource waste; explicit pet talents remain valid exceptions.
items.resolution: Test representative party buffs and timestamp pet ability use while resource-limited and resource-capped. Keep the sourced PowerType values separate from AI latency.

items.title: Summon Hawk guardian model
items.question: How do Hawk attacks, two-Hawk coexistence and inherited stats actually work?
items.current_model: One periodic guardian surrogate: six ticks at three-second intervals using dive-bomb base values. The opening hit uses 5% RAP; this is not a measured complete guardian formula.
items.impact: Pet/Melee row and Hawk alternatives; major model-dependent build opportunity.
items.resolution: Record separate initial and sustained attacks, overlapping summons, duration, hit/crit and owner-stat changes. Aura metadata alone does not supply the full attack profile.

items.title: Arcane Shot, Serpent Sting and Volley SP
items.question: What SP coefficients replace the missing client coefficients?
items.current_model: Retains inherited Arcane Shot/Serpent Sting/Volley coefficients. Zero or dummy client fields are not treated as proof of no scaling.
items.impact: SP-heavy Hunter alternatives and AoE; less important for physical-only loadouts.
items.resolution: Compare controlled SP deltas for Arcane Shot and Sting; test Volley when available. Resolve child effect records before interpreting dummy parent coefficients.

items.title: Auto Shot and special-shot timing
items.question: Does current Forever retain the Classic half-second Auto Shot wind-up and interactions with Aimed/Sniper/Multi-Shot?
items.current_model: Restored original Classic Auto Shot implementation, with sourced special cast times and explicit weapon-cast exceptions. The earlier continuous-autos model is superseded.
items.impact: All ranged Hunter comparisons and haste value.
items.resolution: Capture shot start/release/impact timestamps while alternating each special and Auto Shot; distinguish projectile travel from cast time and movement interruption.

items.title: Pet families and new trained abilities
items.question: Which new family abilities can be added with verified learning paths and effects?
items.current_model: Claw, Bite, Lightning Breath, Screech and Scorpid Poison are supported, not every new teaching record. Wolf Howl and Bat Sonic Blast are not active benchmark pets.
items.impact: Pet selection completeness; not a reason to grant unselected abilities.
items.resolution: Join teaching and child spells to current families/ranks, then implement sourced damage/resource/cooldown behavior. Record unavailable or script-dependent cases individually.

items.title: Dodge-triggered Mongoose Bite window
items.question: Can a dodge activate Defensive State when its aura is initially inactive?
items.current_model: The dodge callback is attached to the conditional aura itself; Expose Prey separately opens the window. The current stationary DPS encounter does not exercise incoming dodges.
items.impact: Solo/reactive Hunter support, not a demonstrated current ranking gain.
items.resolution: Reproduce an incoming dodge from an inactive window; if the listener is unreachable, move the trigger to a permanent listener while retaining sourced duration and eligibility.

items.title: Demoralizing Screech target AP debuff
items.question: Does the pet apply its sourced AP reduction as well as damage?
items.current_model: Damage/rank values are modeled; the target AP reduction is not complete.
items.impact: Tank/solo mitigation with a Screech pet, not selected Cat damage.
items.resolution: Add the target debuff with correct duration and exclusivity, then check incoming damage and pet threat without changing the sourced damage amount.

items.title: Ice Lance coefficient and frozen multiplier
items.question: Is the retained 0.143 SP coefficient correct, and does the frozen multiplier cover the whole hit?
items.current_model: Uses an explicitly assumed 0.143 coefficient and modeled frozen/Fingers interactions; the client damage effect lacks the coefficient.
items.impact: Frost and Arcane–Frost, including comparisons whose baseline casts Ice Lance.
items.resolution: Compare SP deltas on frozen and unfrozen targets; isolate Shatter and Fingers of Frost from ordinary freeze status.

items.title: Fingers of Frost in-flight timing
items.question: Does a cast begun before a chill proc benefit from or consume the resulting charge?
items.current_model: Retains the current event-order interpretation with two charges at max rank. Client charge count does not establish cast-start versus impact timing.
items.impact: Frost/Arcane–Frost proc usage and apparent hybrid gains.
items.resolution: Log aura stacks and cast/impact timing at multiple travel distances; include a cast already underway when the preceding projectile procs Fingers.

items.title: Frostfire cross-school scripts
items.question: Which Fire/Frost talents and Tier effects stack on Frostfire beyond explicitly named client masks?
items.current_model: Explicitly supported interactions are modeled; unresolved cross-school server behavior is not proof that conditional Frostfire research is deployable.
items.impact: Alternate Frostfire hybrids, not the full-rank Arcane–Frost identity by itself.
items.resolution: Use isolated talent/Tier toggles with full-rank Frostfire; resolve each trigger separately from low-rank scaling and Fingers timing.

items.title: Hot Streak interruption and new-charge ordering
items.question: What happens if accelerated Pyroblast is interrupted or new stacks arrive during its cast?
items.current_model: A completed Pyroblast consumes all Hot Streak stacks. Persistent free acceleration is fixed; interruption/in-flight edge behavior is not measured.
items.impact: Fire edge cases; not a reopening of the confirmed consumption fix.
items.resolution: Compare completed and interrupted casts with aura timestamps, including a projectile crit during Pyroblast.

items.title: Clearcasting and Missile Barrage event ordering
items.question: How do channel ticks, last-charge consumption and simultaneous procs interact?
items.current_model: Clearcasting consumes on the next eligible paid damage cast with a one-second trigger ICD. Explicit Missile Barrage timing is retained.
items.impact: Arcane and hybrid resources; ordinary persistent-Clearcasting bug is already fixed.
items.resolution: Capture cost, aura and tick ordering for isolated Arcane Missiles casts with both procs; compare cancellation and completion separately.

items.title: Shadow Word: Death script value 150
items.question: What does the additional dummy/script value do?
items.current_model: Four learned ranks, sourced damage/cost/cooldown, backlash and Early Demise are implemented. No extra execute multiplier is inferred from 150.
items.impact: Shadow damage/execute behavior and possible missing scripted behavior.
items.resolution: Resolve a script description or controlled non-execute/execute damage and backlash samples, holding talents and SP constant. Do not import a different expansion's execute rule.

items.title: Death backlash and Dark Sacrifice modifiers
items.question: Which damage, resistance, absorb and survival rules affect these self-costs?
items.current_model: Death uses its implemented health-backlash interpretation; Dark Sacrifice uses unmodified client amounts and cannot crit. Non-tanking DPS does not model a constrained healer budget.
items.impact: Priest resources/survival, not enemy damage from self-hits.
items.resolution: Measure health/mana deltas with controlled mitigation and absorbs. Separate Death's trigger from Dark Sacrifice's periodic dummy and test lethal/capped-resource cases.

items.title: Inner Focus periodic crit behavior
items.question: Does a permitted periodic spell retain Inner Focus's crit bonus after consumption?
items.current_model: Cost and crit use distinct client masks. Eligible cast-specific behavior is retained; Mind Flay, Death and Starshards do not receive the separate crit bonus merely because they qualify for free cost.
items.impact: Priest alternate DoT/channel priorities.
items.resolution: Test only spells actually included in the crit mask; compare ticks after the aura ends with sufficient crit samples. Do not conflate cost eligibility with crit scope.

items.title: Divine Spirit's baseline acquisition
items.question: Can Priests train Divine Spirit after its talent was removed?
items.current_model: External 40 Spirit coverage is assumed; surviving class-skill rows are not conclusive trainer evidence. Removed Fortitude improvement talents do not multiply the current sourced buff again.
items.impact: Caster/Warlock resources and Spirit-based effects.
items.resolution: Obtain trainer/spellbook evidence for the current build. Keep exact buff value and availability as separate questions.

items.title: Mutilate off-hand flat damage and Cold Blood
items.question: Does the off-hand penalty include Mutilate's flat bonus, and does Cold Blood cover both strikes?
items.current_model: Retains the current main-hand consumption and off-hand flat-component treatment. Puncturing Wounds already applies to both hands.
items.impact: Mutilate damage and cooldown value.
items.resolution: Record both hand outcomes with matched weapons, known AP and Cold Blood; compare low/high flat ranks when available.

items.title: Rogue finisher and poison scaling
items.question: Do the retained AP coefficients and poison proc probabilities match Forever?
items.current_model: Explicit poison base damage is sourced, while several AP shares and 20%/30% proc probabilities retain inherited values. Venom participates in the dynamic periodic model.
items.impact: Rogue build comparisons and poison/physical gear value.
items.resolution: Measure controlled AP deltas for finishers/bleeds and eligible-hit proc counts for each poison. Higher-rank learning is a separate availability question.

items.title: Poison charge depletion
items.question: Can poison charges expire during a supported long encounter?
items.current_model: Finite item charges are not consumed. Current client charge counts are retained as data, not runtime limits.
items.impact: Long fights and very fast attack/proc setups.
items.resolution: Implement charge accounting and reapplication rules from current items, or bound worst-case consumption below available charges for each supported scenario.

items.title: Deadly Poison V acquisition
items.question: Is the highest poison available without an unavailable raid book?
items.current_model: Retained spell/item records do not independently establish acquisition in the allowed content.
items.impact: Conditional highest-rank poison availability; normalized item gear does not make unavailable spells trainable.
items.resolution: Confirm trainer/recipe/book source on current Forever; keep lower legal ranks if the source is unavailable.

items.title: Hack and Slash hand scope and ICD
items.question: Is the 200-ms extra-attack ICD real, and how do mixed weapon bonuses apply?
items.current_model: Retains the inherited ICD and current hand-type gates. Talent rank amounts are sourced, event/stacking semantics are not fully measured.
items.impact: Combat and mixed-weapon alternatives.
items.resolution: Test closely spaced eligible attacks and swap hand placements with known weapon types; separate proc chance from ICD and character-wide armor/crit effects.

items.title: Premeditation expiry and Feint threat
items.question: Are temporary combo points expired and Feint's threat reduction applied?
items.current_model: Premeditation grants points without the sourced 20-second expiry; Feint does not apply its actual threat drop.
items.impact: Prepull/long-idle Rogue setups and threat-constrained encounters, not ordinary sustained damage alone.
items.resolution: Implement the independent sourced duration/threat effects with tests for spending, expiry, reset and target selection; split the record when either is completed.

items.title: Maelstrom Weapon proc rate
items.question: What determines stack frequency and eligible proc events?
items.current_model: Retains 2 PPM per talent point. The client's 4% per point is a cast-time/cost modifier, not a verified proc chance. Only Lightning Bolt spends the modeled buff.
items.impact: Enhancement damage, resources and weapon-speed value.
items.resolution: Count eligible swings/specials and stacks with known speed/talent rank; isolate Windfury and crits. Check current script records before importing a guessed PPM model.

items.title: Instant Maelstrom Lightning Bolt swing reset
items.question: Does a five-stack instant Bolt still reset the next melee swing?
items.current_model: The restored Classic Shaman hook resets next melee to cast completion plus a full swing even at zero cast time. Ordinary hardcasts cannot melee; that does not prove the instant exception.
items.impact: Enhancement APL rankings; all corrected research includes the reset.
items.resolution: Cast at controlled points of the swing cycle with five stacks, logging autos and cast timestamps. Compare partial-stack and instant casts.

items.title: Windfury Weapon extra-attack handling
items.question: Are its proc attacks ordinary extra swings or yellow attacks, with which trigger/cooldown rules?
items.current_model: Retains the existing proc implementation; no dual-wield Shaman or off-hand attack is granted. Totem is a separate buff and cannot proc on the owner's Windfury-imbued weapon.
items.impact: Enhancement weapon/proc value; not the same question as Totem charges.
items.resolution: Record isolated Windfury Weapon events and outcomes, including misses, crits, proc recursion and swing timing; compare against sourced proc spells without importing SoD behavior.

items.title: Owned buff-totem effects and replacement
items.question: Does an APL-cast buff totem actually supply its rank-correct party buff and remove its previous owned buff?
items.current_model: Some owned totems are tracking auras while raid/party settings supply external buffs. Owned Mana Tide/Healing Stream cancellation is implemented; owned Mana Spring regeneration itself remains incomplete.
items.impact: Self-sufficient Shaman/tank-party scenarios and low-rank totem choices; externally supplied ranking buffs must not double count.
items.resolution: Separate external providers from owned totems, implement sourced rank values/party scope and replacement, and test expiry/death/recall without deleting another provider's buff.

items.title: Fire Nova threat owner
items.question: Is Fire Nova threat attributed to the Shaman or the active Fire totem?
items.current_model: Requires a live owned Fire totem; damage and threat are credited to the Shaman.
items.impact: Threat-constrained encounters, not damage amount in a stationary unthreatened DPS run.
items.resolution: Use threat/API observations with an isolated totem and no other damage; keep the verified totem requirement separate.

items.title: Demonic Brand power source and threat
items.question: Whose school power does Brand read, can it crit, and what threat multiplier applies?
items.current_model: Sourced level-60 base/coefficient and target-scoped charges; reads owner matching-school power at hit time, with provisional pet school assignment, noncrit handling and 3× threat.
items.impact: Demonic Pact pet damage and threat; its formula is not just flat demo damage anymore.
items.resolution: Vary owner and pet power independently, compare each demon and direct pet spell, then observe crit/threat and off-target charge behavior.

items.title: Incinerate's Immolate bonus scope
items.question: Does the 25% Immolate bonus multiply base damage only or the whole SP-scaled hit?
items.current_model: Retains the current implementation pending a controlled coefficient test; tooltip wording alone was insufficient.
items.impact: Destruction and alternate Fire rotations.
items.resolution: Compare with/without Immolate at two SP totals and identical talents, separating the normal damage range.

items.title: Wrack's amplified DoT scope
items.question: Which other Shadow DoTs receive its amplification, and exactly when does cancellation remove it?
items.current_model: Channel cancellation works; its modifier ends on cancellation. Current scope is not independently verified for every effect, especially Doom.
items.impact: Affliction channel/DoT interactions.
items.resolution: Compare isolated DoT ticks during and immediately after a deliberately clipped Wrack, one spell at a time, with matched stats.

items.title: Spellstone's Fire/Shadow mask
items.question: Does Spellstone increase both Fire and Shadow power despite Shadow-only wording?
items.current_model: Uses the client's Fire+Shadow mask plus casting speed. Current saved profiles do not select it.
items.impact: Optional weapon imbue, not a current baseline modifier.
items.resolution: Compare Fire and Shadow damage with/without the stone at fixed stats, or obtain a reconciled current tooltip/effect record.

items.title: Fel Armor acquisition
items.question: Is Fel Armor actually available rather than a retained rune record?
items.current_model: Not granted; the misleading duplicate Demon Armor selector was removed.
items.impact: Optional Warlock defensive/resource setup.
items.resolution: Confirm current trainer/spellbook access and effects before adding an independent option.

items.title: Improved Imp's extra dummy effect
items.question: Does the undocumented -300/-700/-1000 effect shorten Firebolt casts?
items.current_model: The suspected cast-time modifier is not inferred from the dummy values alone.
items.impact: Live Imp alternatives; sacrificed Imps do not gain combat damage.
items.resolution: Compare Firebolt start/end times at each talent rank, or resolve the current description/script variables.

items.title: Soul Shards and kill-triggered resource effects
items.question: Can the simulator represent shard costs/refunds and qualifying kills?
items.current_model: No finite Soul Shard inventory or full kill-event model; some shard-related talents have no meaningful cost effect.
items.impact: Short-fight openers, repeated summons and execute/kill scenarios.
items.resolution: Add explicit starting resources, per-spell costs and justified refund/kill events before judging shard-dependent rotations.

items.title: Server downranking penalties
items.question: Does the server apply additional low-rank SP penalties beyond client coefficients?
items.current_model: Uses each captured rank coefficient; no unobserved level-60 penalty is invented.
items.impact: Current rank-2 Smite/Lightning Bolt, lower-rank Paladin choices and conditional Frostfire research.
items.resolution: Measure low and high ranks at the same level across two SP totals; repeat above the learned level. Separate coefficients, base growth and resource costs.

items.title: Projected gear budget and stat prices
items.question: How representative is equal modeled item cost across physical, caster and tank stats?
items.current_model: Hypothetical level-65 items use sourced quantity/armor/weapon tables but assumed nonlinear allocation budgets and special-stat prices. Equal cost is not equal DPS, and Intellect is not generic SP.
items.impact: All cross-class rankings and gear scaling; tank defensive coverage must not be fabricated.
items.resolution: Keep assumptions and per-item proofs visible; replace prices/templates only with supported crafted/PvP comparisons or an explicit scenario decision. Validate selected totals, not only item level.

items.title: Unresolved real-item stats and acquisition
items.question: Which real catalog entries lack authoritative stats, weapon ranges or legal source/race mapping?
items.current_model: Unresolved records and unavailable old-raid/token sources are excluded from eligible selection. Current rankings use modeled items instead.
items.impact: Manual real-gear use and a future actual-loot benchmark.
items.resolution: Resolve each excluded catalog record from vendor exports or current loot evidence, including quest exclusivity and faction/race constraints; do not fill gaps from Classic stats.

items.title: Ordinary equipped-set proc coverage
items.question: Which disabled set thresholds have enough evidence to implement?
items.current_model: Confirmed passive stat thresholds apply at actual piece counts; 44 unsupported thresholds remain omitted. Legacy handlers do not automatically enable catalog effects.
items.impact: Manual real-item sets; synthetic ranking gear has no ordinary set bonuses.
items.resolution: Review each unsupported threshold's effect/trigger chain, source proc rates and runtime routing; add one supported effect with a native piece-count regression at a time.

items.title: Nature's Bounty proc rate and form restrictions
items.question: Is the retained 2% fallback rate correct, and are triggers restricted by active form?
items.current_model: Legacy fallback has separate resource/event routes and Energy ticks over five seconds. Its 2% rate is assumed; catalog proc thresholds remain disabled.
items.impact: Conditional dungeon-set resource behavior, not synthetic rankings.
items.resolution: Count eligible casts/outgoing hits/incoming hits by form with the actual set equipped; distinguish timing already sourced from unknown probability.

items.title: Legacy item and enchant proc assumptions
items.question: Which inherited handlers still use assumed PPM, triggers or obsolete effect values?
items.current_model: Numerous real-item handlers retain explicit assumptions; some source-supported amount updates are known but not imported. Synthetic weapons/trinkets have no implicit item procs, but their selected enchants can supply proc effects.
items.impact: Manual catalog items and proc enchants on the projected gear pool. Form-specific enchant eligibility is tracked separately.
items.resolution: Use the per-item TODOs and manifest IDs to resolve probability, trigger mask, duration and amount independently. The MythicSim review names the outstanding amount corrections; do not verify an entire proc from one number.

items.title: Item guardian stats and attacks
items.question: What are the actual stats, attacks and resource limits of item-summoned guardians?
items.current_model: Eskhandar, Core Hound and Emerald Whelp retain approximate inherited stats/timing. Dragon's Call's flat-damage upstream change was not blindly imported.
items.impact: Optional real-item use; absent from projected equipment.
items.resolution: Capture guardian level, attack outcomes, casts, mana exhaustion and owner-stat changes for each item. Treat each summon as independent evidence.

items.title: Unimplemented vendor item effects
items.question: What prevents Adaptive Combat Assistant, Defender's Grip Stabilizer and Totem of the Storm from being used?
items.current_model: Absorb/explosion, location-dependent modifier and Maelstrom-related proc are excluded rather than supplied as free stats/effects.
items.impact: Future real-item choices; no current modeled-item effect.
items.resolution: Resolve each effect's script/trigger/location requirements and implement only the supported portion with an explicit encounter condition.

items.title: Two Arcanums of Rapidity
items.question: Do identical copies stack additively or multiplicatively?
items.current_model: Each grants attack speed only; identical copies add. Neither is general Energy haste.
items.impact: Melee/ranged swing rates with two copies.
items.resolution: Measure a sufficiently long swing sample with zero, one and two copies under otherwise identical conditions.

items.title: Raw haste rating conversion
items.question: Can future raw haste-rating items be represented without confusing ratings and flat percentages?
items.current_model: Current item/enchant representation handles sourced flat effects; the inherited raw-rating constant is not certified for new Forever rating-bearing items.
items.impact: Future item ingestion and hypothetical gear sensitivity; no selected raw haste-rating item.
items.resolution: Migrate explicit flat-percent versus rating fields using the client 10-rating-per-percent conversion, then test import, UI and engine once without double counting.

items.title: Item-picker shared-crit EP
items.question: Does the gear picker value generic crit for casters the way the engine does?
items.current_model: Engine sharing works, but the picker can dot-product the unprojected MeleeCrit field against zero caster weight. This is a display/valuation limitation, not missing simulated crit.
items.impact: Manual item sorting; native coordinate simulations are not driven by that displayed EP.
items.resolution: Align the picker valuation with actual shared-stat semantics and retain explicitly scoped exceptions. Do not merge all talent/ability crit into one pool.

items.title: Explicitly scoped crit items
items.question: Are any remaining catalog items incorrectly treated as generic crit despite a scoped effect?
items.current_model: Generic equipment fields are shared; checked current flat-crit loadouts had no contradictory scoped record. That does not certify every legacy proc/enchant.
items.impact: Unreviewed manual gear choices.
items.resolution: Audit effect masks for candidates with explicit spell/ranged/school wording and preserve scoped modifiers instead of changing the entire crit system.

items.title: Spell acquisition and source-scanner coverage
items.question: Which retained records are learnable abilities rather than NPC, rune, teaching or obsolete aliases?
items.current_model: Class skill lines supplement class masks; runtime registration and static source coverage are separate. Lower ranks and unresolved generic registration sites are disclosed.
items.impact: Prevents missing real abilities or enabling unavailable ones.
items.resolution: Maintain record-level dispositions in the spell inventory; recheck Black Arrow, Hunter Lacerate, Felfire, Lava Breath, Victory Rush and other held records against actual acquisition chains. Confirm aliases before declaring an omission.
legacy: T50 in check_dispositions.md (acquisition watch) / T05 / H30

items.title: Talent-tree source conflicts
items.question: Which old client/crawl disagreements still affect the legal tree rather than only historical metadata?
items.current_model: Reviewed legal trees and prerequisite tests are retained. Earlier coordinate heuristics produced collisions and illegal allocations; no blind tree replacement was made.
items.impact: Future tree updates and under-reviewed rank values.
items.resolution: Resolve only surviving mismatches against a second current source, preserving spell IDs, curves, grid positions and prerequisites separately; close stale disagreements already corrected by later audits.

items.title: Tank boss damage and external healing
items.question: What incoming damage and healing should define a representative tank comparison?
items.current_model: Explicit stress scenarios: one 300-second boss or three 90-second attackers with fixed swing/AP/armor/healing settings. These are not observed raid bosses or healer behavior.
items.impact: Tank DPS, rage, mana, threat and death rates; cannot be silently equated with un-attacked DPS rows.
items.resolution: Publish the exact assumptions and preserve matched controls; add measured encounters when available. Evaluate survival and least-target threat alongside DPS, not summed TPS alone.

items.title: Non-tank external healing abstraction
items.question: How should health costs constrain Life Tap, Death and self-damaging consumables in DPS scenarios?
items.current_model: Self-damage is excluded from enemy DPS. Non-tanking resource use retains its external-healing abstraction rather than a finite healer budget; tank requests pay real health costs.
items.impact: Resource sustainability and practical healer burden.
items.resolution: Keep damage/resource accounting separate; add an explicit constrained-healing scenario if needed instead of interpreting DPS-only output as survival validation.

items.title: Tank target selection and threat coverage
items.question: Can a tank maintain threat on the weakest-covered enemy rather than repeatedly attacking the first?
items.current_model: Existing Warrior multi-target presets remain single-target focused; summed TPS masks very low threat on an add. No lowest-threat target selector is provided.
items.impact: First-class AoE tank support and meaningful optimization.
items.resolution: Implement explicit target cycling/selection that respects target-local debuffs and proc state; validate per-target threat and maintenance, not just aggregate DPS.

items.title: Tank gear search and exact matrix profiles
items.question: Are all tank races using validated auto-selected gear and full reproducible ranking defaults?
items.current_model: All three tank roles and 17 race profiles have guarded normalized-gear searches, legal talent/APL comparisons, independent-seed confirmation and exact ranking defaults. Tank rows are included in the 31-build, 201-profile matrix with separate survival/threat context.
items.impact: Tank DPS, equipment and rotations are integrated; this does not resolve the class mechanics or projected defensive-stat coverage gaps.
items.resolution: Implemented with frozen controls and explicit safeguards in both single- and three-attacker workloads. Preserve source/model qualifications, especially Seal of Fury, form enchant procs and fixed-target pack threat.

items.title: General absorb-pool and shielding threat
items.question: Do generic shields consume finite incoming damage and generate correct threat?
items.current_model: The generic Shield helper records shielding without a full pool-consumption model or shielding threat. Templar's Bulwark has its own finite pool and is no longer the old 99% reduction shortcut.
items.impact: Priest/healing shields and future Seal of Fury integration; not a reason to revert correct Bulwark behavior.
items.resolution: Implement a reusable absorption/expiry/ordering model with sourced threat rules and separate generated-versus-effective shielding metrics.

items.title: Dynamic pet-provided party buffs
items.question: Do partial talent ranks and pet summon/death transitions update party buffs correctly?
items.current_model: Blood Pact's level-60 value and party scope are fixed, but the automatic provider remains static rather than a full dynamic pet-lifecycle model.
items.impact: Tank health and party simulations involving an Imp.
items.resolution: Model provider activation/deactivation and partial Improved Imp ranks, preserving explicit external coverage separately; test death, dismissal and resummon.

items.title: Healing specializations and utility spellbooks
items.question: Which healing/control-only talents are outside current DPS and tank coverage?
items.current_model: Restoration specializations and much of Priest/Paladin healing are not full supported agents. Utility Tier effects do not invent damage. Individual tank-relevant omissions have their own active entries.
items.impact: Healer simulation and encounters with CC/dispels, not current stationary DPS.
items.resolution: A healer/utility expansion needs sourced spellbooks, targeting and encounter events. Preserve class-pass inventories for Riptide, Wild Growth, shields, healing procs and cooldowns; do not keep them in the urgent DPS test queue.

items.title: In-range and reactive damage omissions
items.question: Which supported damage actions remain missing outside the stationary reference rotation?
items.current_model: Hellfire and Humanoid-only Chastise remain absent; Mage Cone of Cold/Frost Nova are now implemented. Several parry, mana-burn and reactive actions lack encounter support.
items.impact: AoE, solo and alternate target types, not proof of a current five-minute gain.
items.resolution: Use the spell inventory to implement sourced relevant actions and target restrictions. Add encounter conditions before evaluating reactive damage; do not enable NPC/rune leftovers.

items.title: Geometry, movement, kills and latency
items.question: Which real fight events are absent from the stationary benchmark?
items.current_model: No terrain/vertical targeting, realistic movement path, encounter add deaths or general player latency. AoE uses target/range approximations; remainingTime is encounter time, not per-target TTK.
items.impact: Consecration placement, cone targeting, grenades, kill procs, stealth/control and short-lived adds.
items.resolution: Treat these as separate encounter capabilities, not unresolved single-target spell coefficients. Add explicit events/target lifetimes before claiming practical gains based on them.

items.title: Forced Tier 1 and synthetic stat scaling
items.question: What do the Tier-off and +10%/+50% scenarios establish?
items.current_model: Full role Tier 1 is forced independently of equipment. Stat/weapon scaling holds enchants/procs/talents/APLs fixed; amplification is finite-range curvature, not proof of exponential growth or future loot.
items.impact: Interpretation of all matrix gain columns.
items.resolution: Keep explicit settings and exact paired requests. New gear mixes or ordinary-set procs require a different scenario, not relabeling these sensitivities as forecasts.

items.title: Windfury Totem in animal forms
items.question: Does the redesigned party buff proc for Cat and Bear?
items.current_model: Cat/form eligibility is provisionally enabled under the separate party-buff model; the removed weapon-imbue restriction is not conclusive proof.
items.impact: Feral and Bear damage, rage and proc interactions.
items.resolution: Test the actual current Totem on a form Druid with isolated autos, recording buffs and extra swings. Keep Grace of Air excluded during the comparison.

items.title: Other omitted mitigation and threat effects
items.question: Which acknowledged non-DPS effects become relevant with incoming attacks?
items.current_model: Hurricane's attack slow, some pet utility mitigation, Counterspell/Feint threat, general taunt/target switching and legacy encounter behaviors are not a complete tank/raid model.
items.impact: Conditional tank/raid/solo scenarios; not universal current benchmark damage errors.
items.resolution: Promote each effect to a specific actionable entry when its actor/scenario is supported. Source values and encounter activation separately; do not claim broad tank completeness from a single-target test.

items.title: Combustion multi-target charge handling
items.question: Do multiple hits from one Flamestrike independently add and consume Combustion charges?
items.current_model: The callback handles each landed Fire hit individually and carries an explicit Flamestrike TODO.
items.impact: Fire AoE, not the one-target reference rotation.
items.resolution: Record per-target hits and aura changes from one area cast, then reproduce the event ordering before changing the charge model.

items.title: Blade Flurry copied-damage modifiers
items.question: Should copied damage receive attacker or target modifiers a second time?
items.current_model: The inherited secondary-damage path explicitly flags possible double dipping; it is not settled by matching one-target tests.
items.impact: Combat two-target damage and target-armor differences.
items.resolution: Compare original and copied hits against equal and different target armor, with one damage modifier toggled. Trace the current modifier path and correct only the confirmed duplicate.

items.title: Light's Vigil damage support
items.question: Can the supported enemy-target Holy Shock interaction be represented?
items.current_model: The spell is not implemented; the old healer-only dismissal does not establish that every damage application is irrelevant.
items.impact: Conditional Holy Shock builds and spellbook completeness, not a proven gain for existing Ret.
items.resolution: Implement current ranks, cast/cost, next-Holy-Shock bonus/refund and cooldown interaction from explicit sources before evaluating a new build.

items.title: Power Infusion on another raid member
items.question: Can an owned Priest cast Power Infusion on a selected other player?
items.current_model: The owned ability lacks a general target-player option; external buff settings are a separate abstraction.
items.impact: Multi-player raid support and support-DPS comparisons.
items.resolution: Add explicit target selection and ownership/cost/cooldown handling, with no double application of external coverage.

items.title: Legacy regression-suite alignment
items.question: Can the full inherited test suite run against the current Forever data and presets, beyond the maintained release checks?
items.current_model: The release runs targeted mechanics, source-coverage, tank and browser tests. The broader suite still includes excluded Classic items, pre-patch talent metadata, obsolete tree/proto-layout expectations and old landing-page assumptions.
items.impact: Automated regression coverage; a failing legacy fixture is not itself evidence that current game calculations are wrong.
items.resolution: Migrate the stale fixtures and assertions to the current catalog, legal trees and UI contract, preserving meaningful regression checks. Do not change sourced mechanics merely to match older expected numbers. Local cache/file-permission failures are separate environment issues.

items.title: Physical multi-school mitigation
items.question: When armor and magic resistance are similar, which mitigation does a physical multi-school spell select?
items.current_model: The inherited threshold approximation acknowledges that choosing the numerically lowest value is insufficient.
items.impact: Conditional multi-school physical effects; not a generic spell-resistance rewrite.
items.resolution: Identify an available affected ability, then compare known armor/resistance combinations with logged partial resists. Keep this out of unrelated single-school corrections.

items.title: Hunter trigger scopes and shared rank cooldowns
items.question: Are Expose Prey and the audited per-rank cooldown bypasses still incorrect?
items.current_model: Expose Prey excludes generic trap spell hits. Audited Paladin/Warlock spell ranks share timers; Holy Shield requires a shield. Hunter cost and Predator's Edge masks have the later source-backed corrections.
items.impact: Earlier trigger, free-cost and rank-bypass findings are implemented corrections, not open proc-rate tests.
items.resolution: Closed supported predicates/categories with native regressions. Mongoose's separate incoming-dodge listener and other paired utility categories remain distinct entries.

items.title: Healing is not inferred spell damage
items.question: Are pure healing effects accidentally converted to spell damage?
items.current_model: The generic one-third fallback is removed. Sourced hybrid healing/damage effects are imported separately, including enchants.
items.impact: Historical gear/enchant misvaluation; current projected catalogs and real-effect imports retain explicit values.
items.resolution: Closed by source-backed import and enchant corrections. Reopen only for a specific contradictory item/effect, not by assuming all healing has SP.

items.title: Hot Streak and Clearcasting consumption
items.question: Can the old persistent proc buffs still provide repeated accelerated/free casts?
items.current_model: Completed Pyroblast consumes Hot Streak; eligible paid damage casts consume Clearcasting using underlying cost, not the discounted zero.
items.impact: Historical Mage resource/damage error fixed; edge timing has separate active entries.
items.resolution: Closed with client charge/cost checks and regressions; retain MAG-004/MAG-005 for unresolved ordering only.

items.title: Death, Early Demise and Penance timing
items.question: Are these Priest abilities/talents still missing or using evenly spaced Penance bolts?
items.current_model: Four learned Death ranks and Early Demise are registered. Penance hits at 0/1/2 seconds before channel modifiers, not 0.667/1.333/2.
items.impact: Old spellbook/mana/execute omissions corrected; Death script remains separate.
items.resolution: Closed supported implementation gaps; source-scanner discovery now includes class skill lines, not class masks alone.

items.title: Mage Armor, Innervate accounting and timing
items.question: Are Mage Armor and apparent negative Innervate returns still broken?
items.current_model: Current Mage profiles use available Mage Armor. Innervate bonus regeneration has its own accounting; optional external Innervate waits for enough missing mana rather than firing at a fixed 85%.
items.impact: Historical mana/reporting issues; the ranked Mages have no external Innervate.
items.resolution: Closed with matched resource tests and exact-default checks; optional MP5 is not required to fix these defects.

items.title: Shared crit aura, legal imbues and air buffs
items.question: Are Moonkin/Leader and Windfury/Grace still incorrectly stacked?
items.current_model: Moonkin/Leader are one 3% global-crit benefit. Windfury Totem and Grace are exclusive; only Shamans can use Windfury Weapon, and empty/nonweapon slots cannot receive weapon imbues.
items.impact: Confirmed configuration errors corrected; generic crit remains distinct from scoped crit effects.
items.resolution: Closed in engine/UI/default validation. Proc/form semantics remain under separate active IDs.

items.title: Legal armor, shield Block and Bulwark
items.question: Can Feral import plate, do shields lack base Block, or is Bulwark unlimited reduction?
items.current_model: Native armor ceilings reject illegal Druid armor; intrinsic shield Block is imported; Shield Block recasts restore charges; Bulwark is a finite eight-second pool and has no GCD.
items.impact: Reproduced tank/import defects are fixed, not remaining gameplay tests.
items.resolution: Closed by weekly-review regressions. General shield infrastructure and source-dependent talent behavior remain separate.
legacy: W1 / W2 / W4 / W8 / H20 (Bulwark portion)

items.title: Life Tap, Moonfury and explicit pet bonuses
items.question: Are the latest source-backed class-effects fixes actually applied?
items.current_model: Life Tap uses Spirit with separate health/mana accounting; Moonfury multiplies full Arcane/Nature damage; Demonic Knowledge and Focused Fire reach their explicit pet targets. General inheritance already existed.
items.impact: Published fixed-profile correctness release; not pending code changes.
items.resolution: Closed at 3b2d47961 with all 736 fixed-profile scenarios replayed and live verification at b9d8ef4a4.
legacy: T26 (Moonfury portion) / latest upstream source-supported gaps

items.title: Demonic Sacrifice coexistence false lead
items.question: Can a no-Pact Warlock keep sacrifice benefits with an active pet?
items.current_model: Pet reset/enable ordering cancels the sacrifice. Full-run checks recorded zero combat aura/mana benefit without Pact.
items.impact: The earlier code-read suspicion was disproved; not an exploit to optimize.
items.resolution: Closed by full-run ordering/uptime checks, not by adding a redundant guard.

items.title: Lightning Shield's unsupported Earth Shock reset
items.question: Does recasting Lightning Shield reset Earth Shock?
items.current_model: The inherited personal-timer reset is removed. The shared shock timer had already blocked demonstrated extra casts, so it was not a proven DPS exploit.
items.impact: Correctness cleanup, not an unexplained damage gain.
items.resolution: Closed by real-cast timer regression; ordinary charge/proc behavior remains separately sourced.

items.title: Seal of Command SP placement comparison
items.question: Does this engine omit the 70% multiplier on personal SP that upstream added?
items.current_model: No: proc DamageMultiplier is 0.7 × Improved Seals × weapon specialization, with BonusCoefficient 0.29. Personal SP passes through that multiplier; target Holy bonus is applied separately afterward.
items.impact: A recent review overstated the difference by comparing field placement rather than final math. Righteousness remains genuinely unresolved.
items.resolution: Closed the implementation-difference claim by tracing CalcDamage. Further in-game seal trigger/scaling evidence can be tracked without applying the 70% twice.

items.title: Cone of Cold, Frost Nova and owned Mana Tide
items.question: Are the later sourced spell additions still absent?
items.current_model: Mage area spells have ranked damage, cooldowns and 10-yard checks. Owned Mana Tide has its real cast, costs, four pulses and water replacement. Control geometry and owned Mana Spring remain separate gaps.
items.impact: Old spell-coverage pages are historical, not evidence these registrations are missing.
items.resolution: Closed supported additions with rank/cooldown/party tests; retain the narrower remaining limitations.

items.title: Removed and unavailable effects excluded
items.question: Are old Sanctity, Molten Armor, Cat Mangle, campfire raid buffs or Shaman dual wield still granted?
items.current_model: These unsupported choices are excluded; regular Faerie Fire works in supported forms. Surviving legacy records alone do not enable them.
items.impact: Previous illegal/free-effect setups are not current baseline assumptions.
items.resolution: Closed configuration/availability defects. Reopen a particular ability only with a current acquisition source.

items.title: Self-damage is not encounter DPS
items.question: Do Demonic Rune and Sapper self-hits inflate outgoing DPS?
items.current_model: Self-hits are excluded from outgoing encounter damage/threat while preserving damage-taken/resource behavior.
items.impact: Historical accounting inflation fixed; health sustainability is a separate scenario assumption.
items.resolution: Closed by enemy/self-target accounting regressions and refreshed benchmarks.

items.title: Mana restoration threat
items.question: Which mana returns generate threat, who receives it, and is it divided between enemies?
items.current_model: The inherited accounting assigns 0.5 threat per effective mana gained to each enemy for non-exempt returns. Passive regeneration and attributed Innervate are excluded; Vampiric Touch has separate ownership. These source exemptions and per-enemy allocation are not established Forever behavior.
items.impact: Tank TPS and rotation comparisons: wasting mana can increase subsequent effective restoration and its credited threat without improving damage or survival.
items.resolution: Compare isolated available mana returns against a second character's known threat on one and multiple enemies. Start with low-level mana potions; Wisdom and deep-talent returns need later access. Check source-specific client threat flags and ownership before changing the generic accounting.

items.title: Protection seal refresh waste
items.question: Does Protection repeatedly pay for an already active Seal of Righteousness?
items.current_model: The unconditional seal filler is removed. Seal maintenance, paid pre-pull buffs and mana-reserved Consecration replace the wasteful rotation in all three ranked Protection profiles.
items.impact: The old five-minute rotation spent about 16,100 unnecessary mana on seal refreshes. The corrected same-gear/talent rotation gains roughly 10–11% single-target DPS.
items.resolution: Closed by a cast-count regression and independent-seed comparisons against both previous-release and original tank controls, preserving survival and threat safeguards. Ret seal switching is a separate interaction and remains unchanged.
